title: Proportion of teachers with the minimum required qualifications, by education level
graph_title: Proportion of teachers with the minimum required qualifications, by education level
national_indicator_avalable: Proportion of teachers with the minimum required qualifications, by education level
national_indicator_description: This indicator measures the proportion of trained teachers by education level (pre-primary, primary, secondary, and vocational secondary).
computation_definitions: A qualified teacher has the minimum academic qualifications needed to teach at a particular educational level. In pre-primary and primary, a qualified teacher should have at least an advanced secondary certificate (A2). For lower secondary, they should own at least a university diploma (A1), while for upper secondary, they should have at least a bachelor’s degree. A trained teacher is a teacher who has fulfilled at least the minimum organized teacher-training requirements (pre-service or in-service) to teach at a specific level of education. In other words, a trained teacher is a qualified teacher with pedagogical skills. This indicator measures the proportion of trained teachers. Secondary schools are divided between general and professional secondary schools (labeled as "Secondary education") and TVET L1-L5 level schools (labeled as "Vocational secondary education").
computation_calculations: (Number of trained teachers) / (Total number of teachers) * 100
other_info: Significant decreases in the proportion of trained teachers, such as for primary school teachers between 2019 and 2021, can generally be attributed to the recruitment of new teachers without education qualifications due to the shortage of trained teachers. Alternative measures of the proportion of teachers with the minimum required qualifications are available from the [SDG 4 Country Profile for Rwanda](https://download.uis.unesco.org/SDG4/SDG4-Profile-Rwanda.pdf) compiled by UNESCO.
comments_limitations: Lower and upper secondary education levels are not differentiated. Where figures for a given year conflict, the most recent figures have been used.
un_custodian_agency: United Nations Education and Scientific Cultural Organisation - Institute for Statistics (UNESCO-UIS)
